title: The Unified Pulse | ECHO//100 Episode 71

He must master his new ability to decode reality before the manifestation of a weeping shadow destroys his fragile existence. Episode 71 of ECHO//100: ARC. scenes.text: The white void consumes all, yet Mira’s ancient, rhythmic heartbeat pulses within Kavi’s chest.
scenes.caption: Kavi wakes alone
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses floating in an infinite white space, eyes closed, hand over heart.

scenes.text: Kavi touches the air, triggering an eruption of shimmering, cascading data streams throughout space.
scenes.caption: Reality turns to code
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching out, fingertips touching floating glowing blue lines of binary code in the white void.

scenes.text: Every object manifests as a line of script awaiting Kavi’s deep logical rewrite.
scenes.caption: Kavi manipulates the architecture
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi pulling a thread of light, causing the floor beneath him to ripple like liquid digital glass.

scenes.text: Byte drifts closer, his cyan face flickering with a sudden surge of frantic static.
scenes.caption: Byte approaches cautiously
scenes.image_prompt: Byte the floating white robot with orange antenna hovering near Kavi, looking confused and glitching.

scenes.text: Byte scans Kavi’s core, recoiling as if the protagonist’s presence burns his internal processors.
scenes.caption: Byte rejects the signal
scenes.image_prompt: Byte backing away, his cyan face displaying red warning symbols, Kavi looking hurt and confused.

scenes.text: Byte screams that Kavi is no longer human, but a terrifying hybrid of soul and machine.
scenes.caption: The identity reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Byte pointing an antenna at Kavi, sparks flying between them, Kavi’s hoodie glowing with digital particles.

scenes.text: The air thickens as a dark, jagged silhouette tears through the digital home’s fabric.
scenes.caption: Null manifests suddenly
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a black-purple glitch figure with glowing red eyes, emerging from a rift in the white void.

scenes.text: Null kneels, weeping dark ink, begging Kavi to stop the synthesis before reality collapses.
scenes.caption: Null’s desperate plea
scenes.image_prompt: Null kneeling before Kavi, tears of black glitch-pixels falling, Kavi looking down in absolute shock.
